text: This report presents the Auditor's 2025 Audit Work Plan for the audited financial statements for the Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) for the year ended December 31, 2025. KPMG Audit Partner, Kevin Travers, will be attending the November 14, 2025, Audit and Risk Management Committee meeting to review with the Committee, the work plan to deliver the audit for the Toronto Parking Authority's 2025 Financial Statements (see Attachment 1).
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (October 29, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority for information.
